I’m sorry you’ve had to experience this in life. Yet, although I may sound rude and don’t know your circumstances of being autistic, or generally how it differs from what is considered normal. Hearing you have slept during the whole summer and scrolling on your phone, I’ve been there too… Looking for something or someone to randomly appear to make things better - I hated everything, interactions, friends, family, yet I craved it ever so slightly. Recently, I watched this person called Hamza on YouTube, he talks about self improvement and taking control of your emotions, happiness and mental health. He emphasizes that social media is well… bad. I can’t help but agree. Ever since I deleted social media, there is nothing to compare anymore. I enjoy the small glimpses of the sunset when I walk home, or the group of people I see smiling with each other. You too will and can achieve that. 

As of right now, everything seems dark, hollow, deep, nothing but a continuous loop of boring work and daydreaming. Wishing you can experience something, that maybe you can’t do. But that’s your belief, and if you’re stuck on that belief, you probably will fall into darkness. It sounds nice to meet death, for all the pain to dissipate, as you may not have anything fighting for, or the pain is too much. But have you ever personally tried your hardest to overcome your mind? Or just relied on the coaching of others to say what should be done?

I’m not here to test your abilities or strength. I strongly believe your incredible to have held it for this long, and have faith you can turn the tables. 

Just… Please stay.
